Title: Aria Child Recalls Strollers Due to Laceration and Fall Hazards

Retailers.Name: Babies R US and other retail stores

Importers.Name: Aria Child Inc. of Dedham, Mass.

Hazards.Name: A gap in the stroller's folding side hinge can pinch a caregiver's hand during unfolding, posing a laceration hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled strollers and contact Aria Child for a free replacement stroller.
